reviewer_scope: Same assistant through proportional JPEG display copies, with all original PNG hashes rechecked; no independent agent or human review.
observations: The surrounding absorption pattern aligns much better barycentrically across all six own HD128582 epochs.
The central discovery feature is more pronounced in the March30 reference than in the other profiles; the fixed core metrics are mixed and give no clean common-frame repetition.

The native54 profile retains a broad slope different from the merged profile. Only fixed flank divisors are used; no additional response or continuum correction was fitted. Both are extractions from the same exposure.

The original raw54 panel retains a strong central trace/background structure and right-edge residuals at full stored scales. A weak near-center excess is not securely assigned to a charge or photon profile.
The inherited Own0271 heading was corrected to Own0289 in a separate version; every pixel difference lies above the data axes, and the other three figures remain byte exact.
